The most common yellow fruit that monkeys also eat is the banana.

Regarding the press release from CarMakers Inc., the evidence provided is of low quality and low relevance to the claim of superior performance. The claim that the vehicle has a range of 600 miles is unsupported because the company cites proprietary research without sharing the methodology, sample sizes, or comparative data. Without this information, the claim cannot be verified or evaluated against existing models, making the evidence insufficient to substantiate the assertion.
